scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tiendadcc/utils && npm run dev -w tiendadcc-client
scripts.build:ui: npm run build -w tiendadcc-client && rm -rf apps/backend/public && cp -r apps/frontend/client/dist apps/backend/public
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tiendadcc/utils && npm run build:ui && npm run build -w backend
scripts.check: npm run check -w @tiendadcc/utils && npm run check -w backend && npm run check -w tiendadcc-client
scripts.e2e:install: npm --prefix e2etests install && npm --prefix e2etests exec playwright install chromium
